title: The Professional Toolkit — Tool Categories by VAPT Phase
description: Professional security tools are not randomly selected — they map to specific phases of the VAPT methodology. Understanding which category of tool serves which phase prevents the Fatima problem: having thirty tools installed and no idea when to use any of them.

nodes.label:
Reconnaissance
Tools
nodes.detail: Gather information about targets before any active scanning. Used in Phase 2 (Reconnaissance). Examples: Nmap (host discovery), theHarvester (OSINT email/subdomain collection), Maltego (relationship mapping), Shodan (exposed service search), OSINT Framework (aggregates public sources).

nodes.label:
Vulnerability
Scanners
nodes.detail: Automate identification of known vulnerabilities across network and host surfaces. Used in Phase 3 (Scanning & Enumeration). Examples: Nessus (industry standard, commercial), OpenVAS (open-source), Qualys (cloud-based), Nikto (web server scanner).

nodes.label:
Web Application
Testing Tools
nodes.detail: Intercept, inspect, and modify web traffic; discover and test web vulnerabilities. Used in Phases 3 and 4. Examples: Burp Suite (industry standard proxy and scanner), OWASP ZAP (open-source alternative), Gobuster/ffuf (directory and file brute-forcing), SQLMap (automated SQL injection testing).

nodes.label:
Exploitation
Frameworks
nodes.detail: Structured platforms for developing and executing exploits against confirmed vulnerabilities. Used in Phase 4 (Exploitation). Examples: Metasploit (open-source, industry standard), Cobalt Strike (commercial, used in red team engagements), Havoc (open-source C2 framework).

nodes.label:
Credential &
Password Tools
nodes.detail: Test password strength, crack hashes, perform credential attacks. Used in Phases 3 and 4. Examples: Hashcat (GPU-accelerated hash cracking), John the Ripper (multi-format hash cracker), Hydra (online login brute force), CrackMapExec (credential testing across Windows environments).

nodes.label:
Traffic
Analysis
nodes.detail: Capture and inspect network traffic to understand protocols, identify cleartext credentials, and analyse attack patterns. Used across phases. Examples: Wireshark (full packet capture and analysis), tcpdump (command-line packet capture).

nodes.label:
Post-Exploitation
Tools
nodes.detail: Enumerate privileges, extract credentials, map Active Directory, and assess lateral movement potential after initial access. Used in PTES Phase 6 (Post-Exploitation). Examples: Mimikatz (Windows credential extraction), BloodHound (Active Directory relationship mapping), PowerView (AD enumeration).

nodes.label:
Phase 2
Reconnaissance
nodes.detail: Passive and active information gathering about the target.

nodes.label:
Phase 3
Scanning
nodes.detail: Port scanning, service detection, vulnerability scanning, enumeration.

nodes.label:
Phase 4
Exploitation
nodes.detail: Confirmed exploitation of vulnerabilities within scope.

nodes.label:
PTES Phase 6
Post-Exploitation
nodes.detail: Privilege escalation, lateral movement, data reachability assessment.
